methods.name: int cmd_refs_migrate(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)

methods.description: Checks if a specific reference exists in the repository.

methods.name: int cmd_refs_optimize(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo)
